# Vendored Karoo Extensions SDK

Source: https://github.com/hammerheadnav/karoo-ext
Commit: `f79f103cd0e1a9808db64474796b30d822cc0b17` (master downloaded 2026-10-06)
Library version: 1.1.9
License: Apache-2.0, see LICENSE; original file copyright headers retained.

Only lib/src/main was copied. Source files are unmodified. The local Gradle
build file is simplified to omit publishing and documentation tooling and
uses JVM 17. Vendoring avoids requiring GitHub Packages credentials to build.

Before updating, compare the upstream source, license and protocol compatibility.
